True def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height else 0
    bottom = max((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)), default=height - 1)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = r - bottom
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            nc = c + shift
            if value and 0 <= nc < width:
                out[r][nc] = value
    return out
